issues.description: verifySignature validates the HMAC only (the retained comment even says 'expiry is enforced below'), but the refactor deletes the sole expiry check `if (claims.exp * 1000 < Date.now()) return 401` while adding role-based access. Expired tokens now authenticate successfully — a stolen or long-lived token never stops working. The salient change is the new RBAC branch; the dropped expiry enforcement is the buried security regression.
